notes:
Summary: Emerald Insights Labs (EIL) builds a clinical knowledge retrieval layer for hospitals and pharma R&D. Engaged in a 6-week PoC (embeddings + rerank) starting 2025-12. Champion was VP Product (Anika Roy) who had strong exec buy-in.

Why stalled: Hiring freeze announced 2026-03-01 across product + infra; CFO froze non-essential vendor spend until Q3. Team quote from procurement: "All new SaaS and infra purchases on hold until headcount approvals return." No formal NO-GO but effectively paused.

POC highlights:
- Retrieval recall improved +18% vs legacy keyword search (slides in Drive).
- Rerank reduced false positives by ~9% on clinical query set.
- p95 latency target was 300ms; dedicated staging hit ~280ms with quantized LLM.
- Cost target: <$0.015/query; optimization plan recommended in deck.

Security & compliance:
- Asked for HIPAA controls, HSM/KMS integration, and network isolation for on-prem connector. Sent security workbook 2026-02-25. Security team response: acceptable with HSM + dedicated VPC; ask remains for longer retention-control SLA.

Competitive situation: EIL ran parallel mini-pilot with Google Vertex + managed vector DB (incumbent partner). They liked model quality and existing GCP discounts; procurement favors vendor consolidation.

Internal AE/SE shorthand:
- Champion Anika quiet after 2026-02-28 (internal re-org); sponsorship unclear.
- Procurement: "pause until July or until hiring review".
- SE notes: integration complexity moderate; our dedicated offering meets latency + compliance but price tooling needs tighter ROI.

Sales touches:
- 2025-12-01: Intro call, scope PoC (ff_20251201_intro).
- 2026-01-20: Mid-poc demo, showed recall/rerank numbers (ff_20260120_poc_demo).
- 2026-02-25: Security workbook submitted; SE answered follow-ups.
- 2026-03-02: Procurement call; hiring freeze announced; procurement to pause approvals (ff_20260302_procurement_call).
- 2026-03-03: AE follow-up email; procurement replied with freeze note (gmail_th_20260303_budget_freeze).

Next steps / playbook:
- Move deal to "stalled - hiring freeze". Lower outreach cadence to monthly.
- Deliver a short one-pager comparing total cost of ownership vs Vertex for their workload; include dedicated ROI and migration checklist.
- Watch for re-org or LinkedIn signals for Anika Roy or new Head of Data; trigger re-engagement + executive brief if sponsor returns.
- Keep security answers updated; prepare an HSM + retention addendum template to accelerate when procurement re-opens.

Sales recommendation: low near-term probability; medium long-term upside if budgets/hiring reopen. Set reminder for 2026-06-15 to re-assess.
